verdict.rationale: The only anti-bot evidence is a marketing claim that CAPTCHAs are 'handled' (docs-10) and that agents can get through login walls on any website (docs-8). That suggests some bot-mitigation capability, but nothing describes an undetected or stealth browser mode. Missing for 10: a documented stealth/undetected browser mode, fingerprinting or detection-evasion details, evidence of bypassing sophisticated bot-detection systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
